processed_event_ids.purpose: prevent double-counting the same attempt after reload/retry
processed_event_ids.implementation_note: May be compacted later with session/event journal; first local version can keep a bounded recent-id list.

state_revision.purpose: increment after each newly applied event; useful for debug/migration tests

idempotency_rules: If event_id already exists in processed_event_ids, reducer returns state unchanged.
A replayed browser event must not increment seen/correct/wrong counts.
processed_event_ids must be updated atomically with the aggregate exception state in the implementation layer.
Compaction of old event IDs must not occur until an equivalent durable idempotency strategy exists.
mastery_boundary: This addendum does not define mastery thresholds or spaced-repetition intervals. It only defines safe event aggregation and idempotency.
